summary: Five valid close reviews identify two agreed evidence gaps. The coordinator will exercise role reversal and retain reproducible wheel and fixture checks. Gemini returned a malformed response.

agreed_concerns.title: Reproducibility of the fixture and installed-wheel parity checks
agreed_concerns.summary: Record the exact build, install, parity, eight-command and fixture-sweep commands verbatim, with interpreter and module/CLI paths, or check them in as a script. Rerun them at close against the final HEAD and record the output in the close delta. Record the exact sweep command and the fixture-validity selection rule alongside the count (or promote the sweep to a gate or regression test) so the headline path-vs-loaded-model parity claim can be re-run and re-verified at close.

agreed_concerns.title: Reversed role bindings lack an executable negative case
agreed_concerns.summary: Have the example derive role bindings from the occurrence against the fact's ordered roles. Add a test showing that a swapped binding, or an occurrence like 'V-1 has version W-1', is not recorded as reuse. Drop the redundant inequality. Add a negative-case regression that ties the recorded bindings to the source occurrence (for example, assert that the reversed assignment contradicts the captured span's subject-role order, or that a role-player search with swapped players cannot reproduce the occurrence), so the stated acceptance criterion is machine-checked rather than pinned only to the example's recorded value.
